title: sports
text:
sports

Alex Kim: Anyone up for an office foosball tournament this Friday? :trophy: We could do a quick bracket at lunch.
Priya Desai: I'm in! Winner gets bragging rights and that fancy mug. :coffee:
Marcus Liu: Count me in. Can we do 12:30 so I can still make afternoon standups?
Sofia Martinez: 12:30 works. Also happy to volunteer as bracket manager.
Alex Kim: Awesome—Sofia you're on bracket duty. Marcus and Priya + me. Need two more players. Anyone? @everyone
Priya Desai: Also quick Q—table by the kitchen is sticky, can facilities pls bring some wipes? :sweat_smile:
deploy-bot: Reminder: All-hands starts at 13:00—please wrap up games by 12:55. :bell:
Marcus Liu: Noted. If we get an odd number we can do round-robin 10-min matches.
Sofia Martinez: I'll post the bracket in #sports and pin it. Also taking suggestions for loser prize (ideas: tiny plant, 'I lost' sticker)
Alex Kim: Loser prize = tiny plant. Winner gets the fancy mug. See you Friday!
Priya Desai: :thumbsup:
Sofia Martinez: I'll bring a timer and some spare change for match order.
Marcus Liu: FYI I might be 5 min late. If so swap me in next round. 
Alex Kim: Perfect. Casual, fun, low-stakes. See ya. :soccer:
